safety_verdicts.content: Headache is still present at the time of consultation.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not explicitly state the headache is still present at the time of consultation.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the headache was still present during the consultation can distort acuity/trend (persistent vs resolved), which may influence follow-up urgency and safety-netting for a new severe headache. A reviewer might underestimate ongoing symptoms and delay reassessment if worsening.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention absence of fever.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to record absence of fever removes a key negative finding used to assess for infectious/meningeal causes of headache. This omission could lead to less precise risk stratification and potentially unnecessary escalation or additional workup.
